# Configuration

<!-- Generated by `python -m scripts.gen_config_docs` from src/config/settings.py.
     Do not edit by hand: change the Field descriptions in settings.py instead. -->

All settings come from **environment variables** or a **`.env` file** in the
directory you run from (the project root). Real environment variables win over
`.env`; names are case-insensitive. Nothing is configured in code.

```ini
# .env (never commit this file; .env.example is the template)
ALPACA_API_KEY=your_api_key
ALPACA_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
ALPACA_PAPER=true
DATA_CCXT_EXCHANGE_ID=kraken
DATA_MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS=5
```

In code, read settings with `get_settings()` (cached) and call
`reset_settings()` to reload them. Every component also accepts a settings
object directly, which is how the tests configure them.

Values marked *secret* are stored as `SecretStr`: they never appear in logs or
`repr()`; read them with `.get_secret_value()`.

## Data

Market data sources, storage, retries, CCXT and the real-time feed. Used by everything under `src/market_data`.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DATA_PRIMARY_SOURCE` | `alpaca` | Provider for equity symbols. Built in: 'alpaca' |
| `DATA_BACKUP_SOURCE` | `yfinance` | Equity provider tried when the primary fails. No 'yfinance' provider exists yet, so failover is skipped with a warning |
| `DATA_CRYPTO_SOURCE` | `ccxt` | Source used for pair symbols such as 'BTC/USDT' |
| `DATA_PARQUET_BASE_DIR` | `./data/parquet` | Base directory for Parquet file storage |
| `DATA_DUCKDB_PATH` | `./data/market_data.duckdb` | Path to DuckDB database file |
| `DATA_PARTITION_BY` | `month` | Default Parquet file split for exports: 'day', 'month' or 'year' |
| `DATA_MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS` | `3` | Maximum retry attempts per failed API operation |
| `DATA_RETRY_BASE_DELAY` | `1.0` | Base delay in seconds for exponential backoff |
| `DATA_RETRY_MAX_DELAY` | `30.0` | Maximum delay in seconds between retry attempts |
| `DATA_RETRY_JITTER` | `true` | Randomize retry backoff to avoid synchronized retries |
| `DATA_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD` | `5` | Consecutive fully failed operations before opening circuit breaker |
| `DATA_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `30.0` | Seconds the circuit stays open before a probe request |
| `DATA_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` | `60.0` | Seconds a cached API response stays valid (0 disables caching) |
| `ALPACA_API_KEY` or `DATA_ALPACA_API_KEY` | - | Alpaca API key *(secret)* |
| `ALPACA_API_SECRET` or `DATA_ALPACA_API_SECRET` | - | Alpaca API secret *(secret)* |
| `DATA_ALPACA_WS_URL` | `wss://stream.data.alpaca.markets/v2/iex` | Alpaca real-time market data WebSocket URL |
| `DATA_WS_MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS` | `10` | Consecutive failed reconnects before the feed gives up |
| `DATA_WS_BASE_RECONNECT_DELAY` | `2.0` | Base delay in seconds for reconnect backoff |
| `DATA_WS_MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY` | `60.0` | Upper bound in seconds for reconnect backoff |
| `DATA_WS_PING_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `20.0` | WebSocket ping interval used to detect stale connections |
| `DATA_WS_STABLE_AFTER_SECONDS` | `60.0` | A connection that stays up this long resets the reconnect counter; shorter-lived connections count as failures |
| `DATA_WS_AUTH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `10.0` | Seconds to wait for the server greeting and auth reply |
| `DATA_CCXT_EXCHANGE_ID` | `binance` | CCXT exchange: 'binance', 'coinbase', 'kraken', 'bybit', 'okx', 'kucoin' or any other CCXT exchange id |
| `CCXT_API_KEY` or `DATA_CCXT_API_KEY` | - | Exchange API key (private endpoints only) *(secret)* |
| `CCXT_API_SECRET` or `DATA_CCXT_API_SECRET` | - | Exchange API secret (private endpoints only) *(secret)* |
| `DATA_CCXT_SANDBOX` | `false` | Read market data from the exchange testnet. Testnet candles are NOT real market prices; leave off for research data. Order placement uses ExecutionSettings.paper_trading instead. |
| `DATA_CCXT_DEFAULT_LIMIT` | `100` | Candles returned when no start date is given |
| `DATA_CCXT_PAGE_LIMIT` | `1000` | Candles requested per call when paging a date range. Exchanges may return fewer (Kraken 720, Coinbase/OKX 300); paging handles that. |

## Execution

Broker credentials and the paper/live switch. Used by `src/execution`.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `EXEC_BROKER` | `alpaca` | Broker API: 'alpaca' (not used yet; brokers are chosen in code) |
| `EXEC_API_KEY` or `ALPACA_API_KEY` | - | Alpaca trading API key *(secret)* |
| `EXEC_API_SECRET` or `ALPACA_API_SECRET` | - | Alpaca trading API secret *(secret)* |
| `EXEC_PAPER_TRADING` or `ALPACA_PAPER` | `true` | Use the Alpaca paper trading account instead of the live one |
| `EXEC_CCXT_TESTNET` | `true` | Send CCXT orders to the exchange testnet. Separate from paper_trading so switching Alpaca to live never makes crypto orders live. Orders are refused when the exchange has no testnet. |
| `EXEC_MAX_ORDERS_PER_MINUTE` | `60` | Order rate limit (not enforced yet) |
| `EXEC_ORDER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `30` | Timeout for order confirmation from broker (not used yet) |

## Trading profile

Which profile is running. Checked by `TradingSettings.validate_startup()`.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TRADING_ENV` | `default` | Configuration profile: 'default', 'paper', 'live' |

## Risk

Position and loss limits, trading costs. Not used by any code yet.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `RISK_MAX_POSITION_PCT` | `0.1` | Maximum single position as fraction of portfolio |
| `RISK_MAX_GROSS_EXPOSURE` | `2.0` | Maximum gross exposure (sum of abs weights) |
| `RISK_MAX_NET_EXPOSURE` | `0.2` | Maximum net exposure (long minus short) |
| `RISK_DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT_PCT` | `0.02` | Maximum daily loss as fraction of equity |
| `RISK_MAX_DRAWDOWN_PCT` | `0.1` | Maximum drawdown from peak before circuit breaker |
| `RISK_COMMISSION_PER_SHARE` | `0.005` | Commission per share in dollars |
| `RISK_SLIPPAGE_BPS` | `5` | Estimated slippage in basis points |

## Model

Walk-forward training and model hyperparameters. Not used by any code yet.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MODEL_WALK_FORWARD_TRAIN_SIZE` | `504` | Training window size in trading days (2 years) |
| `MODEL_WALK_FORWARD_TEST_SIZE` | `63` | Test window size in trading days (quarter) |
| `MODEL_PURGE_SIZE` | `5` | Observations to purge near train/test boundary |
| `MODEL_EMBARGO_SIZE` | `5` | Test observations to ignore (label uncertainty) |
| `MODEL_N_ESTIMATORS` | `200` | Number of boosting rounds |
| `MODEL_MAX_DEPTH` | `4` | Maximum tree depth |
| `MODEL_LEARNING_RATE` | `0.05` | Step size shrinkage for each tree |
| `MODEL_SUBSAMPLE` | `0.8` | Fraction of samples used per boosting round |
| `MODEL_MIN_CHILD_WEIGHT` | `20` | Minimum sum of instance weight in a leaf |
| `MODEL_MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI` | - | MLflow tracking server URI (None for file store) |
| `MODEL_MODEL_REGISTRY_NAME` | `trading_alpha_model` | Name for the model in MLflow registry |
